items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: And we had Sophie Tuggett, Joey Lewis, and Connie Boswell.

ctx.x: Yeah, but not much. Fair enough. We had four of them. We'd go back next season for the racing season. And we had Sophie Tuggett, Joey Lewis, and Connie Boswell. Now you know he must be a good entertainer to play those places. I was with him, oh I made some money with that guy. Boswell's sister. Huh? Boswell's sister. Yeah.
Well who was the, I think starting him out was Bill Coker. Did you know Bill Coker?
